culprit_citations.quoted_text: evidence_cli tables output identifies the raw filing accession as 0001193125-26-115988; the flagged C006 artifact row has accession_number value "" for row_key 548357.

findings.detail: The filing-derived BDC/HTML row is missing accession_number even though the raw source bundle resolves to accession 0001193125-26-115988.

citation.quoted_text: raw source accession 0001193125-26-115988; flagged row_key 548357 accession_number value ""

rationale: C006 requires source traceability via accession_number. The evidence CLI successfully read the raw source and reported accession 0001193125-26-115988 for this filing, while the flagged artifact row has an empty accession_number. The source therefore decides the issue: the row is missing a required traceability value that is available from the filing metadata.
